name: House cleaning
summary: Start a house cleaning business: your first 25 people and partners, a price menu from real local ranges, instant quotes by bedrooms and bathrooms, and messages for every step.
door_step3: I clean, you check, I send photos

promises.first_25: 15 people you know and 10 local agents, managers and hosts, each with a message, plus door hangers with this month's offer.

promises.reply: Paste what someone wrote back: what they meant, a short answer with one next step, and your Pipeline updated. A draft you send yourself.
promises.won: Log the yes, then everything for the clean: the booking text, a prep text, a printable job sheet, the after-job text and the invoice.
promises.proof: One clean turned into proof: a result card, a before-and-after collage from your photos, a caption, an honest review ask and a case study once they say yes.
promises.next_25: The next 25 agents, managers, hosts and movers near you that are not in your Pipeline yet, each with its messages, saved for Do my day.

steps: Before the visit: confirm address, entry method (key, lockbox or door code), pets, parking, priority rooms, add-ons and the price in writing.
On arrival: quick walkthrough with the client or their notes; photograph any existing damage or problem areas.
Work top to bottom and dry to wet: dust high surfaces, fans and fixtures first, floors last.
Kitchen: wipe appliance fronts and counters, clean and polish the sink, wipe cabinet fronts, empty trash, sweep and mop.
Bathrooms: scrub sink and counters, clean mirrors, scrub shower or tub, clean and disinfect the toilet, sweep and mop.
Bedrooms and living areas: dust surfaces, empty wastebaskets, make beds or change linens if booked, tidy, vacuum.
Add-ons booked for this visit: inside oven, inside fridge, interior cabinets, interior windows, laundry.
Final walkthrough against the checklist, after photos, lights off, lock up, reset any alarm.
Same day: send the invoice or charge the card on file, ask for a review, and book the next visit.

sources.says: Standard cleaning includes sweeping, mopping, vacuuming, dusting and tidying; bathrooms include sweeping and mopping, scrubbing the sink and counters, cleaning mirrors, scrubbing the shower or tub, cleaning and disinfecting the toilet; get the agreement in writing.
Kitchen tasks include wiping appliances and counters, polishing sinks, cleaning windows, sweeping and mopping; bedroom tasks include dusting, emptying wastebaskets and floors.

job_checklist.note: The order of steps (top to bottom, dry to wet) and the before and after photos are common practice, a judgment call.
